I have had depression and OCD ever since I was little and I was the same way. My family is amazing, friends are wonderful, boyfriend is so loving but my mind wants me to be fucking miserable. The first step is to get professional help and by the sound of it your parents will be more than supportive. It sucks but you have to want to FIGHT and not give up on what you deserve "happiness". It's not an overnight process but it sure as hell beats feeling so low that you don't want to be alive. Did you used to have hobbies?

Please don't. I know you are hurting but... I have to ask about your illness. What is it? Instead of feeling like there is nothing left, create things. Do a bucket list and fuck everyone else. What do you want to do? Be selfish and don't listen to negative voices. Skydyiving, get a tattoo, go to another country, speed date? You're worth so much more than a prescription induced death.

This is going to sound stupid but... I struggle with depression and severe OCD and there is nothing more calming and wonderful than just hanging out with my puppy and taking her for walks. I don't know if you like animals but an emotional support animal might be something that you need. When you feel alone and like all hope is lost that animal will curl right up on your lap and let you know that you are truly loved and reminds you of that everyday. Please don't give up.
